node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one base-field conic router
node.statement: On the h=7 conic, both z=-1 points are excluded by the non-prime-field invariant. If the remaining line parameter t lies in F_p, Frobenius forces zeta=2-z; official Mersenne congruences then force zeta=-1 and z=3. This branch is empty at p=8191,131071 and reduces at p=524287,2147483647 to at most the two signs in 7w^2=5308, with c^2-3c+1=0 and rho^p=-c*rho.
node.notes: Exact branch router only. The two larger-row sign packets still owe every trace/cyclotomic/inner condition, and t outside the prime field is untouched.
